meta.description: Approximate inter-body leg metrics for the journey, for gameplay pacing and scoring.
meta.source: JPL Horizons (https://ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/api/horizons.api); values below are real-world references, approximated and scaled for play.
meta.note: Regenerate precise elements and travel times with scripts/build_space_data.py. Unknown values are null and should be filled by the build script or tuned in-game.

legs.note: Mars to Jupiter system leg; idealised Hohmann values. Real missions use gravity assists. Gameplay may scale distance and time.
legs.method: Hohmann approximation from NSSDCA semi-major axes; ignores gravity assists, phasing, and capture. Idealised values.

legs.note: Mars to Saturn system leg; idealised Hohmann values. Real missions use gravity assists. Gameplay may scale distance and time.
legs.method: Hohmann approximation from NSSDCA semi-major axes; ignores gravity assists, phasing, and capture. Idealised values.

legs.note: Surface colony branch; no interplanetary transfer.
